### SEM

```{r}
library(semTools)
library(lavaan)

model_buric_t4_sem <- "
MI_EmEx =~ EmEx1_4 + EmEx2_4 + EmEx3_4 + EmEx4_4 + EmEx6_4
MI_Anger =~ Ang1_4 + Ang2_4 + Ang3_4 + Ang4_4
MI_Anxiety =~ Anx1_4 + Anx2_4 + Anx3_4 + Anx4_4
MI_Joy =~ Joy1_4 + Joy2_4 + Joy3_4 + Joy4_4

MI_EmEx ~ MI_Anger + MI_Anxiety + MI_Joy + T3GENDER + T3EXP

"
fit_buric_t4 <- sem(model_buric_t4_sem, data = data_buric)
summary(fit_buric_t4, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

lavInspect(fit_buric_t4, "nobs")
```

```{r}
parameterEstimates(fit_buric_t4, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
```

```{r}
model_joy_negaff <- "
MI_EmEx =~ EmEx1_4 + EmEx2_4 + EmEx3_4 + EmEx4_4 + EmEx6_4
MI_NegAff =~ Ang1_4 + Ang2_4 + Ang3_4 + Ang4_4 + Anx1_4 + Anx2_4 + Anx3_4 + Anx4_4 
MI_Joy =~ Joy1_4 + Joy2_4 + Joy3_4 + Joy4_4

MI_EmEx ~ MI_NegAff + MI_Joy + T3GENDER + T3EXP

"

fit_model_joy_negaff <- sem(model_joy_negaff , data = data_buric)
summary(fit_model_joy_negaff, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

```

```{r}
fit_model_joy_negaff <- sem(
  model_joy_negaff,
  data = data_buric,
  se = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 500
)

standardizedSolution(fit_model_joy_negaff, ci = TRUE)
```

## CFAs Buric

```{r}
library(lavaan)

# 1 Factor CFA => Negative Affect

model_1factor_NegAff_4 <- '
  NegAff =~ Anx1_4 + Anx2_4 + Anx3_4 + Anx4_4 +
            Ang1_4 + Ang2_4 + Ang3_4 + Ang4_4
'

fit_1factor_NegAff_4 <- cfa(
  model_1factor_NegAff_4,
  data = data_buric,
  estimator = "MLR",
  missing = "fiml"
)

summary(fit_1factor_NegAff_4, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# 2 Factor CFA => Anger and Anxiety

model_2factor_NegAff_4 <- '
  Anx =~ Anx1_4 + Anx2_4 + Anx3_4 + Anx4_4
  Ang =~ Ang1_4 + Ang2_4 + Ang3_4 + Ang4_4
'

fit_2factor_NegAff_4 <- cfa(
  model_2factor_NegAff_4,
  data = data_buric,
  estimator = "MLR",
  missing = "fiml"
)

summary(fit_2factor_NegAff_4, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

  eigen_type_other = c("SMC"),
  gof = "CAF",
  method = "PAF"
)
